notable_features.text: Portuguese is a Western Romance language with a very large phoneme inventory of 47 sounds, reflecting its rich system of vowels, nasal vowels, and diphthongs typical of Romance languages. It follows a basic subject-verb-object (SVO) word order and marks five distinct tense/aspect categories, indicating a fairly elaborate verbal system. As the most widely spoken language in the Southern Hemisphere, it also serves as an official or co-official language across multiple countries on several continents.
